categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of micro motors and intelligent components for household appliances, new energy vehicles, medical instruments, and industrial control. Its main product categories include air conditioner motors and components, washing machine motors and components, refrigerator motors and components, small appliance motors and components, automotive motors and parts, medical and sports health motors and components, and industrial control motors and components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced motor drive system solutions, focusing on modular and integrated electromechanical-soft products. It employs intelligent manufacturing with over 35 automated production lines and has developed proprietary technologies such as brushless motors, laser radar motors for new energy vehicles, and precision casting and stamping components. The company also emphasizes R&D in high-efficiency stator-integrated stepper motors, automotive DC motors, and intelligent control systems, supported by provincial-level technology centers and patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international household appliance manufacturers such as Gree, Midea, Haier, Electrolux, Whirlpool, LG, Samsung, Panasonic, and GE. The company also serves automotive parts suppliers in the new energy vehicle sector, medical instrument manufacturers like Mindray and Siemens Healthineers, and industrial control equipment producers. The markets span household appliances, new energy vehicles, medical devices, and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiangsu Leili operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and production bases in North America (USA and Mexico), Europe, Southeast Asia (Vietnam), South Korea, and Hong Kong. The company maintains a significant export business, with approximately 45% of revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of micro motors, motor components, and intelligent modules. It supplies core components directly to OEMs in household appliances, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors, and also engages in upstream activities through acquisitions of suppliers and investments in related manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on integrating motor and control systems, modularization, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D priorities include developing high-efficiency, low-noise motors, automotive laser radar motors, electric air conditioning compressor motors, and medical-grade motor components. The company invests in smart factory automation, digital transformation, and expanding product lines in new energy vehicles, medical devices, and industrial control, aiming for cross-sector growth and enhanced market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of micro motors, motor components, and intelligent modules to OEM customers in household appliances, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributor channels for some products, with long-term framework agreements and order-based deliveries. It also earns income from investment gains and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Leili is a leading domestic and global player in the micro motor and intelligent component manufacturing industry. It holds a strong market position with recognized technology leadership and a broad customer base. Competitors include other specialized motor manufacturers serving household appliances, automotive, and industrial sectors, but Leili differentiates itself through integrated solutions, automation, and international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.08 billion, a 6.1% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 317 million, up 22.44%. Total assets reached about RMB 5.76 billion, growing 16.4% from the previous year. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest in automation and R&D, targeting a 13.75% revenue growth for 2024 with a sales goal of RMB 3.5 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Leili emphasizes its role as an expert in motor drive system solutions, offering high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced micro motors and intelligent components. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, automated smart manufacturing, and close collaboration with leading OEMs for synchronized product development. The company provides diversified, modularized products tailored to multiple application fields, supporting customers' innovation and efficiency needs.
